description: Prescriptions router (full CRUD + file upload + OCR trigger) and medicines router (list grouped by active ingredient + update). Depends on FEAT-001 (Prescription, PrescriptionMedicine models) and FEAT-002 (conftest.py test infra). These two routers are bundled together because the medicine router operates on PrescriptionMedicine rows that prescriptions create.
steps: Create backend/app/schemas/prescription.py: PrescriptionListItem(id, doctor_id, doctor_name: str|None, prescription_date: date|None, ocr_status, patient_notes, medicine_count: int, created_at, updated_at) with from_attributes=True. PrescriptionDetail(id, doctor_id, doctor_name, prescription_date, ocr_status, document_url: str|None, patient_notes, medicines: list[PrescriptionMedicineResponse], created_at, updated_at). CreatePrescriptionResponse(id, ocr_status, created_at). UpdatePrescriptionRequest(prescription_date: date|None, doctor_id: str|None, patient_notes: str|None — all Optional). OcrTriggerResponse(prescription_id, ocr_status, job_id). PrescriptionListResponse(prescriptions, total, page, page_size).

Create backend/app/schemas/medicine.py: PrescriptionMedicineResponse(id, prescription_id, brand_name, active_ingredient, active_ingredient_slug, strength, formulation, dosage, frequency, route, duration, review_state, medicine_status, confidence_score, source_reference, created_at, updated_at) with from_attributes=True. MedicineOccurrence(prescription_medicine_id, brand_name, strength, formulation, dosage, doctor_name, prescription_date, prescription_id, medicine_status). MedicineGroup(active_ingredient, generic_name: str|None, occurrences: list[MedicineOccurrence]). MedicineListResponse(medicines: list[MedicineGroup], total, page, page_size). UpdateMedicineRequest(brand_name, active_ingredient, strength, formulation, dosage, frequency, route, duration, review_state, medicine_status — all Optional str).

Create backend/app/services/prescription_service.py: PrescriptionService(db: AsyncSession, upload_dir: str). list_prescriptions(patient_id, page, page_size, ocr_status_filter, doctor_id_filter) -> (list[Prescription], total): use select with filters and count. get(prescription_id, patient_id) -> Prescription | None: single prescription with joined doctor. create(patient_id, file_bytes, filename, content_type, prescription_date, doctor_id, patient_notes) -> Prescription: validate file size (<= MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES) and MIME (image/jpeg, image/png, application/pdf) — raise 413/415 via raise_http_error if invalid; save file to UPLOAD_DIR/{patient_id}/{prescription_id}/original_{filename} (prevent path traversal by using os.path.basename on filename and uuid for prescription_id before path construction); create Prescription row with ocr_status='PENDING'; return. get_document_path(prescription_id, patient_id) -> str | None. update(prescription_id, patient_id, data) -> Prescription. delete(prescription_id, patient_id): delete Prescription row (cascade deletes medicines + alerts via DB cascade); delete file from disk. trigger_ocr(prescription_id, patient_id) -> dict with prescription_id, ocr_status='PROCESSING', job_id: check not already PROCESSING (409), update status, generate job_id UUID, return dict (actual OCR worker integration is out of scope — this is the API stub).

Create backend/app/routers/prescriptions.py: GET /patients/me/prescriptions (200), POST /patients/me/prescriptions (201, multipart/form-data using UploadFile + Form fields), GET /patients/me/prescriptions/{prescription_id} (200), GET /patients/me/prescriptions/{prescription_id}/document (streams file using FileResponse), PUT /patients/me/prescriptions/{prescription_id} (200), DELETE /patients/me/prescriptions/{prescription_id} (204), POST /patients/me/prescriptions/{prescription_id}/ocr (202). Also PUT /patients/me/prescriptions/{prescription_id}/medicines/{medicine_id} (200) — delegates to medicine_service. All require get_current_patient.

Create backend/app/services/medicine_service.py: MedicineService(db: AsyncSession). list_grouped(patient_id, search, doctor_id_filter, medicine_status_filter, page, page_size) -> (list of MedicineGroup dicts, total): query PrescriptionMedicine joined to Prescription and Doctor, group by active_ingredient_slug in Python (SQLite lacks window functions), apply filters. get_by_slug(patient_id, slug) -> MedicineGroup dict | None. update(medicine_id, patient_id, data: UpdateMedicineRequest) -> PrescriptionMedicine: fetch by id, verify prescription.patient_id == patient_id (404 otherwise), apply non-None fields, recompute active_ingredient_slug if active_ingredient changed (slug = ingredient.lower().replace(' ', '-')), commit, return.

Create backend/app/routers/medicines.py: GET /patients/me/medicines (200, MedicineListResponse), GET /patients/me/medicines/{active_ingredient_slug} (200, single MedicineGroup). Both require get_current_patient. Medicine update PUT is handled via the prescriptions router at /patients/me/prescriptions/{id}/medicines/{id}.
Update backend/app/main.py: include prescriptions.router and medicines.router under /api/v1 prefix.

Create backend/tests/test_prescriptions.py: test_upload_prescription_returns_201, test_upload_prescription_returns_401_unauthenticated, test_upload_prescription_returns_413_for_oversized_file, test_upload_prescription_returns_415_for_unsupported_type, test_get_prescription_returns_404_for_other_patient, test_list_prescriptions_returns_empty_initially, test_update_prescription_metadata_returns_200, test_delete_prescription_returns_204_and_removes_from_list, test_trigger_ocr_returns_202, test_trigger_ocr_returns_409_when_already_processing. Use synthetic data: fake small PNG bytes for file upload (1x1 pixel PNG), doctor_name='Dr. Synthetic'.

Create backend/tests/test_medicines.py: test_list_medicines_returns_empty_initially, test_list_medicines_returns_grouped_by_active_ingredient, test_update_medicine_review_state_returns_200, test_update_medicine_returns_404_for_other_patient, test_get_medicine_by_slug_returns_404_for_missing_slug. Use synthetic medicine data: brand_name='Synthamol 500mg', active_ingredient='synthamol'.
Commit: feat: prescriptions and medicines routers with file upload and tests
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/v1/patients/me/prescriptions with valid image/png file returns 201 with id and ocr_status='PENDING'
GET /api/v1/patients/me/prescriptions/{id} for another patient's prescription returns 404
DELETE /api/v1/patients/me/prescriptions/{id} returns 204 and subsequent GET returns 404
POST /api/v1/patients/me/prescriptions/{id}/ocr again when already PROCESSING returns 409
verification: $env:JWT_SECRET_KEY='synthetic-test-secret'; $env:DATABASE_URL='sqlite+aiosqlite:///./test.db'; cd backend && python -m pytest tests/test_prescriptions.py tests/test_medicines.py -v
findings: Prescriptions router at /api/v1/patients/me/prescriptions (GET list, POST upload, GET single, GET document, PUT update, DELETE, POST /ocr). Medicines router at /api/v1/patients/me/medicines (GET grouped list, GET by slug). Medicine update PUT at /api/v1/patients/me/prescriptions/{id}/medicines/{id}. PrescriptionService.create() validates MIME (image/jpeg, image/png, application/pdf) and size (<=MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES=10MB), returns 415/413 on error. OCR trigger stub returns 202 with job_id UUID; 409 if already PROCESSING. MedicineService.list_grouped() groups by active_ingredient_slug in Python. All 15 new tests pass; full suite 38/38 green. Files added: app/schemas/prescription.py, app/schemas/medicine.py, app/services/prescription_service.py, app/services/medicine_service.py, app/routers/prescriptions.py, app/routers/medicines.py, tests/test_prescriptions.py, tests/test_medicines.py. UPLOAD_DIR defaults to ./uploads (from config.py). Later steps should note: actual OCR worker integration (FEAT-005 or similar) will call prescription_service.trigger_ocr() to set status, then update to COMPLETED/FAILED.
